# The Gantry Tools

> Free browser-based calculators, document generators and plain guides for small businesses in Singapore: GST at 9%, InvoiceNow, EDGE grants, progress claims, payment terms, stock and WhatsApp Business. No signup; entries stay in the user's browser. Written and maintained by Sayed Rashid, a former auditor who sets up business systems for small companies. Companion articles are published at https://www.gantry.work. Figures on each page carry the date they were checked and link to the official source (IRAS, IMDA, Enterprise Singapore, MOM, Meta, vendor pricing pages).

Updated 19 November 2026. Every page below is free to use and to cite.

## Start here
- [All free tools](https://tools.gantry.work/): 55 tools and guides grouped by the problem they fix: late payments, stock, job costs, margins, paperwork, grants and InvoiceNow, WhatsApp.
- [SME Systems Health Check](https://tools.gantry.work/health-check/): ten questions, about 60 seconds, a score and the process that leaks the most time.
- [Cost of Manual Work Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/cost-of-manual-work.html): what retyping, chasing and checking cost a team in a year.
- [ERP Readiness Scorecard](https://tools.gantry.work/erp-readiness.html): eight questions on data, process, ownership and time before buying a system.
- [Singapore SME Systems Checklist](https://tools.gantry.work/singapore-sme-systems-checklist.html): 12 printable, scored checks to pass before buying an ERP or inventory system.

## GST, InvoiceNow and grants (Singapore)
- [GST Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/gst-calculator.html): add or remove 9% GST (multiply or divide by 1.09; GST inside a GST-inclusive price is 9/109), one amount or a list.
- [InvoiceNow Implementation Date Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/invoicenow-deadline.html): a web version of the IRAS calculator; GST status in, mandatory InvoiceNow date out, every phase from 2025 to 2031.
- [How InvoiceNow Works](https://tools.gantry.work/invoicenow-explained.html): one invoice followed through five stops, from the seller's system to the customer and IRAS; Peppol ID, dates, costs and grants.
- [Free InvoiceNow Solutions](https://tools.gantry.work/invoicenow-free.html): the free-of-charge packages on the official IRAS list, what each covers and their expiry dates.
- [InvoiceNow Grants](https://tools.gantry.work/invoicenow-grants.html): IMDA's fixed payouts (S$1,000, S$5,000 for own-ERP integration, S$25,000 Queen Bee) and who qualifies.
- [InvoiceNow Providers vs Access Points](https://tools.gantry.work/invoicenow-providers.html): what an InvoiceNow-Ready Solution Provider does versus an Access Point Provider, checked against IMDA's list.
- [Is My Accounting Software InvoiceNow-Ready?](https://tools.gantry.work/invoicenow-software.html): Xero, QuickBooks, Odoo, SAP, NetSuite, Sage, Dynamics, ABSS, AutoCount and Zoho against IMDA's accredited list.
- [EDGE Grant Calculator for ERP](https://tools.gantry.work/edge-grant-calculator.html): up to 50% for SMEs and 30% for non-SMEs; the Integrated ERP activity caps qualifying cost at S$60,000, so an SME gets at most S$30,000.

## Get paid faster
- [Overdue Invoice Reminder Writer](https://tools.gantry.work/invoice-chaser.html): upload a Xero or QuickBooks aged receivables export and get the right reminder for every late customer.
- [AR Aging Report Generator](https://tools.gantry.work/ar-aging-report.html): aging buckets by customer, overdue totals, DSO and statements from one export.
- [Statement of Account Generator](https://tools.gantry.work/statement-of-account-generator.html): a statement for every customer with open invoices, aging and total due, as PDF.
- [DSO Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/dso-calculator.html): DSO = receivables ÷ credit sales × days in the period; days beyond terms and cash tied up.
- [Invoice Due Date Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/invoice-due-date-calculator.html): due dates on net 7 to net 90 and net 30 EOM, days overdue, late interest and early payment discounts such as 2/10 net 30 (the annualised cost of skipping the discount).
- [Get-Paid Kit](https://tools.gantry.work/get-paid-kit.html): payment reminder wording for day 1, 7 and 14, a statement cover note, a call script and a stop-supply rule. Free PDF.

## Documents (free PDF generators)
- [Invoice Generator](https://tools.gantry.work/invoice-generator.html): PDF invoices and Singapore GST tax invoices with logo, numbering and payment details.
- [Quotation Generator](https://tools.gantry.work/quotation-generator.html): quotes with GST and a validity date that turn into an invoice in one click.
- [Receipt Generator](https://tools.gantry.work/receipt-generator.html): payment receipts for cash, PayNow, bank transfer or card.
- [Delivery Order Generator](https://tools.gantry.work/delivery-order-generator.html): delivery orders with a receiver signature block and no prices.
- [Purchase Order Generator](https://tools.gantry.work/purchase-order-generator.html): numbered purchase orders with supplier, delivery date and terms.

## Margins, pricing and profit
- [Profit Margin Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/profit-margin-calculator.html): any two of cost, price and margin give the third; reprice a whole list to a target margin.
- [Markup Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/markup-calculator.html): markup to margin and back, with GST and break-even.
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/break-even-calculator.html): break-even units = fixed costs ÷ (price − variable cost per unit), plus margin of safety.
- [Gross Profit Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/gross-profit-calculator.html): gross and net margin, with a cost of goods sold helper from stock counts.
- [Price Increase Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/price-increase-calculator.html): the % change between two prices and the price that keeps your margin when costs rise.
- [Restaurant Margin Checklist](https://tools.gantry.work/restaurant-margin-checklist.html): a weekly 15-minute check of delivery app fees, food cost and wastage for Singapore F&B.

## Stock, purchasing and imports
- [Three-Way Match Guide and Checker](https://tools.gantry.work/three-way-match-guide.html): purchase order, goods received note and supplier invoice; worked example (100 ordered, 96 received, 100 invoiced) and a live checker.
- [Reorder Point and Safety Stock Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/reorder-point-calculator.html): reorder point = average daily demand x lead time + safety stock; safety stock by z-score (z x std dev of daily demand x square root of lead time), max-minus-average or days of cover, with the Excel formulas.
- [Landed Cost Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/landed-cost-calculator.html): foreign price, exchange rate, freight, insurance, duty, 9% import GST and local charges per unit.
- [Slow-Moving Stock Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/slow-moving-stock-calculator.html): months of cover = quantity on hand ÷ average monthly usage, a stock class and a suggested provision.
- [Stock Take Variance Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/stock-take-variance-calculator.html): record accuracy, lines within tolerance and variance value.
- [Year-End Stock Take Checklist](https://tools.gantry.work/year-end-stock-take-checklist.html): count plan, freeze and cut-off note and a count sheet. Free PDF.
- [Inventory Software Cost Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/inventory-software-cost-calculator.html): 12-month cost of Zoho Inventory, inFlow, Cin7 Core, Unleashed and Odoo from users, locations and orders.

## Construction and job costs
- [Progress Claim Calculator (Singapore)](https://tools.gantry.work/progress-claim-calculator.html): work done to date + variations + materials on site, less retention and previous claims certified, plus GST; cumulative.
- [Job Costing Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/job-costing-calculator.html): cost to date against budget and percentage complete, projected final cost, overrun and unbilled work.
- [Mobile Job Sheet in Jotform](https://tools.gantry.work/jotform-job-sheet.html): a phone job sheet the customer signs on site, saved to Google Sheets with a PDF to the office.

## Month-end, cash flow and staff
- [Month-End Close Cost Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/month-end-close.html): what a slow close costs in salary every year.
- [Month-End and Year-End Close Checklist](https://tools.gantry.work/december-close-checklist.html): day by day, with a test for each step and the Singapore dates a late close holds up.
- [13-Week Cash Flow Forecast with Singapore Dates](https://tools.gantry.work/13-week-cash-flow-calendar.html): 7 Dec 2026 to 7 Mar 2027 with CPF, levy, GST, ECI and property tax dates from the official pages.
- [Payslip Generator (Singapore)](https://tools.gantry.work/payslip-generator-singapore.html): an itemised payslip with the 12 items MOM requires (employer, employee, payment date, basic salary, salary period, allowances, additional payments, deductions, overtime hours, overtime pay, overtime period, net salary); print, PDF or CSV for Excel.
- [Overtime Calculator (Singapore)](https://tools.gantry.work/overtime-calculator-singapore.html): MOM's formula, hourly basic rate = 12 x monthly basic / (52 x 44), overtime at 1.5x; covers non-workmen up to S$2,600 and workmen up to S$4,500 basic; 72 hours a month cap; pay within 14 days.
- [Annual Leave Calculator (Singapore)](https://tools.gantry.work/annual-leave-calculator-singapore.html): Employment Act annual leave from MOM: 7 days in year 1 of service, +1 a year, 14 from year 8; after 3 months; first-year pro-rating = completed months / 12 x entitlement (under half a day down, half or more up); carry forward 12 months under Part 4; unused leave paid at the gross rate (12 x monthly gross / (52 x days a week)) when employment ends, except dismissal for misconduct.
- [Sick Leave Calculator (Singapore)](https://tools.gantry.work/sick-leave-calculator-singapore.html): MOM paid sick leave after 3 months of service: 5 outpatient / 15 hospitalisation days at 3 months, 8 / 30 at 4, 11 / 45 at 5, 14 / 60 from 6 months; the 60 hospitalisation days include the 14 outpatient days; paid at the gross rate.
- [Singapore Public Holidays 2027 and Holiday Pay](https://tools.gantry.work/singapore-public-holidays-2027.html): the 11 public holidays for 2027 from MOM (Chinese New Year Sat 6 and Sun 7 Feb, so Mon 8 Feb is a holiday for Sunday rest-day staff; 6 Feb, 1 May and 25 Dec fall on a Saturday, owed as another day off or a day's gross pay on a 5-day week); working a holiday = an extra day at the basic rate, 12 x monthly basic / (52 x days a week); long weekends; .ics and CSV downloads.
- [Singapore Business Deadlines 2027](https://tools.gantry.work/singapore-business-deadlines-2027.html): every 2027 compliance date for a Singapore company by year end and GST period: GST one month after each period (31 Jan, 30 Apr, 31 Jul, 31 Oct for standard quarters), CPF by the 14th (15 Feb, 15 Mar, 16 Aug, 15 Nov when the 14th is a weekend), IR8A by 1 Mar, ECI within 3 months, AGM within 6 months, ACRA annual return within 7 months, Form C-S by 30 Nov; each with its IRAS, CPF Board or ACRA source; .ics and CSV downloads.
- [Notice Period Calculator (Singapore)](https://tools.gantry.work/notice-period-calculator-singapore.html): the last day of notice counted the way MOM counts it (includes the day notice is given, rest days and public holidays), Employment Act minimums, leave offset and salary in lieu.
- [Timesheet Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/timesheet-calculator.html): hours, breaks, overnight shifts, overtime at 1.5x and weekly pay, with print and CSV.
- [ERP and Automation ROI Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/erp-roi.html): payback in years and value at year 7, 10 and 15.

## For finance and operations heads (system projects)
- [Stalled System Project Rescue Checklist](https://tools.gantry.work/system-project-rescue-checklist.html): why ERP and system projects stall (the data, the opening balances and the links have no owner inside the business), 12 checks, and the order to restart: owners, feature freeze, signed-off data and balances, links tested with real documents, then the go-live date.
- [Month-End Close Scorecard](https://tools.gantry.work/month-end-close-scorecard.html): 10 questions for finance heads on where a long close waits (supplier invoices, stock vs the ledger, bank lines, intercompany, consolidation in Excel) and the close order: cut-off, bank, suppliers and accruals, stock and payroll, intercompany, margin and reports.
- [What a System Project Really Consists Of](https://tools.gantry.work/system-project-parts-checklist.html): the nine parts of an ERP or system project (software, implementation, industry changes, data migration, links, training, your own people's time, support after go-live, a reserve for the unexpected) and a check for which parts a proposal leaves out.
- [Data Migration Readiness Test](https://tools.gantry.work/data-migration-readiness-test.html): 12 questions before an ERP data migration; master data first, software second; count and clean, owners and sign-off, test load into a copy, opening balances tied to the trial balance, then the real load.

## WhatsApp Business and automation
- [WhatsApp Business API Cost Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/whatsapp-api-cost-calculator.html): the monthly bill at Meta's Singapore rates, the October 2026 change to replies and provider plans on top.
- [WATI for a Small Team in Singapore](https://tools.gantry.work/wati-guide.html): what WATI is, who needs it and who does not, and what a team of 3, 5 or 10 pays.
- [WATI Pricing Singapore](https://tools.gantry.work/wati-pricing-singapore.html): Growth and Pro plans in Singapore dollars, monthly or yearly, with a team-size calculator.
- [WATI Free Trial Test Plan](https://tools.gantry.work/wati-free-trial-plan.html): what the 7-day trial includes, what it cannot do and a day-by-day test.
- [WATI Go-Live Checklist](https://tools.gantry.work/wati-go-live-checklist.html): eight things to have ready before connecting a business number.
- [Shared WhatsApp Inbox Fit Check](https://tools.gantry.work/wati-fit-check.html): stay on the free WhatsApp Business app, fix the free things first, or move to a shared inbox.
- [Make.com Credit Calculator](https://tools.gantry.work/make-credit-calculator.html): credits a scenario uses each month and the plan it needs.
- [Free n8n Blueprints](https://tools.gantry.work/blueprints/): five tested workflow files: overdue Xero invoices, supplier bills, a daily owner report, lead routing and WhatsApp orders.
